verdict.rationale: The evidence only describes SSO in general terms: authenticate once with an IdP and gain access to connected service providers. Nothing documents a catalog of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations, its size, or quick setup in place of custom projects. The 'eliminates the need to build custom integrations' claim concerns the MCP server for AI agents, a different story, so it does not transfer.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects
